title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Dev Ops Engineer to join our dynamic team at LUMIQ. In this critical role, you will lead our Dev Ops team, overseeing day-to-day operations and ensuring effective stakeholder management and executive reporting. You will lead our teams to follow and establish best practices, implementing the most efficient Dev Ops practices and designs across both internal and customer projects, where we build and deploy Data & AI platforms, our products and their use cases. You will be responsible for ensuring that all our Dev Ops engagements are completed on time while providing the right level of support and stakeholder engagement throughout the process. Requirements Required skills: Expert knowledge of Linux system & networking internals, and Container runtimes. Significant experience with one or more major cloud providers
- AWS, GCP, Azure. Hands-on with IAC (Infra as Code)
- Terraform or others. Solid understanding of running apps in container environments, dockerising applications and orchestration using Kubernetes, helm and service mesh deployments. Open-source tooling & configuration exposure with nginx, httpd, ansible or equivalent. Hands-on with development and deployment of CI/CD on cloud. Server-side scripting using bash, python or equivalent. Excellent communication, interpersonal, collaboration and documentation skills. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Team-oriented with strong collaboration, prioritization, and adaptability skills. Ability to understand the end-to-end business requirements, proposing them a feasible solution & implementing them in a better way to produce error free products for our clients. Systems & architectural design Dev Ops best practices & implementation. Mentoring & coaching fellow engineers.

QUALIFICATIONS:
6+ years of experience in the role of infrastructure, Dev Ops, platform or SRE engineering. Thorough understanding of software development lifecycle and infra engineering best practices. Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Technology or equivalent experience. Proven experience in leading and managing a team of Dev Ops engineers in previous roles. Benefits What do you get: Opportunity to contribute to an entrepreneurial culture and exposure to the startup hustler culture. Collaborative and innovative work environment Opportunity to contribute to an entrepreneurial culture and exposure to the startup hustler culture. Competitive Salary Packages. Group Medical Policies. Equal Employment Opportunity. Maternity Leave. Opportunities for upskilling and exposure to the latest technologies. 100% Sponsorship for certification. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Dev Ops Engineer to join our dynamic team at LUMIQ. As a Dev Ops Engineer at LUMIQ, you wi Job Description Job Description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Dev Ops Engineer to join our dynamic team at LUMIQ. As a Dev Ops Engineer at LUMIQ, you will play a critical role in designing and implementing Dev Ops solutions across both internal and external projects. Your focus will be on building robust Dev Ops processes that drive efficiency, scalability, and automation within the project landscape. You will work at the intersection of automation, system reliability, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient deployment processes. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement in operational workflows and help deliver high-performance solutions for our customers. Requirements Required skills: Sound knowledge of Linux system & networking internals, and Container runtimes. Experience working with one or more cloud providers
- AWS, GCP, Azure. Hands-on with IAC (Infra as Code)
- Terraform or others. Solid understanding of running apps in container environments, dockerising applications and orchestration using Kubernetes, helm and service mesh deployments. Open-source tooling and configuration management exposure with nginx or httpd, ansible or others. Hands-on with development and deployment of CI/CD on cloud or Jenkins and similar. Server-side scripting using bash, python or equivalent. Decent communication, interpersonal, collaboration and documentation skills Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Team-oriented with strong collaboration, prioritization, and adaptability skills.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred. 3+ Years of experience in the role of infrastructure, Dev Ops, platform. Thorough understanding of software development lifecycle and infra engineering best practices. Bonus points (nice to have or preferred skills but not mandatory): Exposure working with databases, data analytics and warehousing services on cloud. Exposure to architectural and systems designing best practices. Exposure of working in Professional Services. Familiarity of BFSI domain. Familiarity and understanding of Data, Snowflake, AI and ML Benefits What do you get: Opportunity to contribute to an entrepreneurial culture and exposure to the startup hustler culture. Collaborative and innovative work environment Opportunity to contribute to an entrepreneurial culture and exposure to the startup hustler culture. Competitive Salary Packages. Group Medical Policies. Equal Employment Opportunity. Maternity Leave. Opportunities for upskilling and exposure to the latest technologies. 100% Sponsorship for certification. title: Application Architect
jobDescription:
Job Description Role Summary: · Designing secure and scalable systems and applications for various industries using AWS/GCP/Azure or similar services. · Integrations between different systems/applications/browser and network. · Analysis of business requirements and selection of appropriate solutions for the AWS platform · Delivering high speed, pixel perfect web applications. · Well aware of the latest technology trends, hands-on
- modern architecture, Microservices, Containers, Kubernetes etc. · Solving design and technical problems · Well aware-of all design patterns/architectures · Hands-on latest tech stack
- MEAN, MERN, Java, Lambdas, etc. · Hands-on CI/CD and Dev Ops. · Communication with the customer (with both Business and IT) · Supporting Pre-Sales team in workshops with customers and offering preparation · It is good to have multiple cloud platform solution knowledge
- AWS, GCP or Azure, at least one is must.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Facilitate technical discussions with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders as needed through all phases of customer engagements. • Provide domain expertise around public cloud and enterprise technology, and promote Google Cloud with customers, at conferences, and online. • Create and deliver best practice recommendations, tutorials, blog posts, sample code, and presentations adapted to technical, business, and executive partners. • Provide customer and market feedback to product and engineering teams to help define product direction. • Work as part of a broader Solutions Go-to-Market team to contribute technical assets, prioritize and shape solution direction, while impacting top line business and bookings. • Ensure that the deliveries from the team members should meet the delivery schedule with optimum quality. • Seminar for architectural experience and training for Tech-Leads Requirements Application Ecosystem Tech Stack Reference: · Programming Language (at least one) [Java-script/Typescript(preferred), HTML, Java (Spring Boot)] · Microservice architecture, PWA, responsive app, micro-front end, Socket based integration, Static File server, server-side/client-side rendering, IAM/RBAC based user control integration with applications, vertical or horizontal scale/load management. · Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, nginx, HA proxy, Jenkins or similar CI-CD tools. · Loopback, Express, Next JS, Nest JS, React/Angular. · Data modeling for no Sql or Sql databases · Cloud equivalents like AWS Cloud Front, AWS Lambda, Azure Cloud Front, AWS EKS/ECS and others · Apache Kafka (KStreams, KSQL, KSQLDB), AWS SQS, Pub-Sub or similar queuing system. · Git Version Control, Github or equivalents like bit bucket, Git lab release & branch management experience. · Engineering background – B.Tech/ M.Tech/ Ph D Nice to Have: • Demonstrated understanding of Sql or no Sql Databases, encryption/decryption and application governance. • Experience in architectural solutions for Financial Services domain – banking, insurance, mutual fund or similar • Work with sales teams, in a partnership model to pro-actively research accounts involved with to identify client's pain areas/business challenges, and design appropriate solutions for pro-active proposals. • Detailed Exposure to at least one of the following cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure • Experience designing serverless, secure web applications. • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment • Certifications from Cloud or Data Solutions Providers like AWS, GCP, etc. Benefits Group Medical polices
- INR 5,00,000 with Private room. title: Industry Consultant - Capital Markets
jobDescription:
Job Description LUMIQ is seeking a proactive and customer-centric Account Manager to join our dynamic team. The Account Manager will play a pivotal role in managing and nurturing existing client accounts and facilitating a smooth transition of accounts from Business Development to Account Management, according to LUMIQ’s defined processes. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality solutions that align with their business objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Recommending new strategies for improving customer service or increasing revenue from existing products or services • Fair level of understanding across following business domains: o Investment Banking & Brokerage – Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Exchange and Trade Operations and Compliance o Asset and Wealth Management
- Front Office, Middle Office and Back Office with understanding of the business of Indian AMCs, RTA o Securities Services – Asset Servicing(Clearing and Settlement, Custody Services, Corporate Actions and Securities Lending), Fund Services, Alternative Investments and Institutional Services • Training new employees in capital markets systems, procedures and policies to ensure that they are familiar with their new jobs. • Developing proposals for enhancing client’s data and analytics maturity and assisting with implementation • Providing consulting services to Investment Managers, Asset Management Company, Brokerage Firms, Custodians regarding technology or operations issues • Evaluating clients performance to help management identify problems that may require intervention • Reviewing financial statements to assess the health of a company’s finances. • Provide expert industry insights and advice to both internal teams and external clients. • Conduct thorough research and analysis to stay ahead of industry trends and developments. • Lead and participate in client meetings, offering high-level strategic guidance and knowledge. • Develop and present tailored presentations to clients, showcasing our understanding and capabilities in the Capital Markets industry. • Serve as a thought leader in the industry, participating in panel discussions, conferences, and writing white papers or articles. • Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices. Requirements Experience & Skills • Min 7 years of relevant experience across firms working in Capital Markets/Investment Banking Domain • The candidate should understand evolving business and technology landscape of processes, data and technologies used. • Knowledge and understanding of Custody applications from both functional and technical perspectives is essential. • Must have experience interfacing with IT teams with limited exposure to the business. This is primarily an IT role. • Excellent communication, negotiation, networking and influencing skills; excellent consumer relationship management skill with service-oriented mindset. • Ability to work in fast paced environment; possess excellent written verbal communication skills. • Advanced knowledge in MS Office products Educational Qualification – ​ Post Graduate, preferably premier B-school Areas – Specialized in any across Front, Middle and Back Office. Broad understanding of Trade Lifecycle and Asset Classes Special Call out – Experience in data projects would carry preference above usual ADM project Benefits Benefits: • Group Medicalpolices-INR5,00,000with Privateroom. title: Account Manager - Sales
jobDescription:
Job Description Role Summary What is the purpose of this role? Why does it exist? This role is accountable for customer relationship management and mining of named key customer accounts Experience & Skills OVERALL EXPERIENCE 7-10 years of experience in Strategic Account Management Experience in working across levels in the Customer Organization Experience in the IT Products Industry preferable FUNCTIONAL EXPERIENCE Specialist in Relationship management Keen understanding of customer needs and a track record of consultative selling and solutioning Hands-on in negotiating pricing agreements Proven ability to grow accounts significantly Skilled in multi-level customer engagement Techno-commercial knowledge LEADERSHIP SKILLS Experience in working and aligning with Solutions Architects and Delivery Managers Ability to create an impact in the Customer’s Organization PERSONAL SKILLS Results driven Strong relationship skills – an extrovert Self driven
- don't wait for others to push Continuous learner
- hungry to learn and experiment Solution focussed
- hunts for problems and focuses on solving them in timely and effective manner; ability to anticipate and re-align Trustworthy
- someone to lean & count on Committed
- figures out how to get something done Logical & Street Smart with critical thinking skills; Flexible
- ready for adjustment for success of assignments Empathetic
- good listener and being able to put oneself into others shoes PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Engineer (BTech) & MBA ORGANISATIONAL STRUCTURE Reporting to Sales Head Key Accountabilities What are the most important deliverables and outputs/outcomes the role is primarily responsible for? Revenue Growth of strategic business in each named account CSAT for each account Growth of share of wallet in each account Creative proposals and pricing models for complex customer situations Support Marketing efforts positioning the Company as a dominant player in the respective target market Requirements Roles and Responsibilities Major R&R of this role are: Growth of Revenue and Profitability numbers for the key accounts Development and implementation of growth strategies for each account Tracking of competition in the Key accounts and remain ahead Pre-emption and resolution of issues, working with the customer and the Delivery teams to manage escalations Building of a reputation of ‘easiest to work with’ with each Key Account Application of market research and market analysis to improve customer experiences Development of ‘pipeline’ strategies and flow models to ensure targeted order inflows are achieved and balanced into Projects Ideation / design / co-creation of innovative solutions for Key Client. Go-to person both internally and in the Key Client’s organization for customer information, competitor information and market information Moving of the relationship from vendor / supplier to trusted partner / partner of choice Voice of customer with in Lumiq Responsibility for RFI & RFP to customer Internal / External Interactions Who is the natural work team internally? Who in the external world does the role-holder have to influence? Internal
- Business Leaders, Tech Leads External
- Customer teams, CXOs Time Horizon & Impact to Organisation What impact can the role make? What is the ‘legacy’ he/she wants to leave behind? Over what timeframe can performance be judged? Contribute to company growth Should establish the Company as a partner of choice in the Customer’s organization in 12 months Customer account growth New initiatives driven for the customer account Benefits Group Medical polices
- INR 5,00,000 with Private room.
